verdict.rationale: Jan's docs claim autonomous task execution ("works on it autonomously") and autonomous agents that take actions via messaging apps. That covers one-off autonomous runs, but nothing documents setting up recurring or scheduled automations, triggers, or background execution, and MCP tool calls require individual user approval. These agent claims may also depend on connected tools such as OpenClaw. missing for 10: documented recurring schedules or triggers for automations, explicit background/unattended execution, configuration docs for setting up automations, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Give Jan a task and it works on it autonomously — files, commands, and web research.
Autonomous AI agents that run on your hardware — read files, manage calendars, and take actions via WhatsApp, Discord, or Slack.
